caveats: individualTaxYear is the calendar year, inferred from the country's annual assessment cycle (grade I); not confirmed on the authority's own pages in this pass.
companyYearEndDefault is a 31 December app default for new entities (grade I), not a statutory requirement; companies may choose other year ends under national law.
Rates and effective dates confirmed on vero.fi: the general rate rose from 24% to 25.5% on 1 September 2024 and the reduced rate from 14% to 13.5% on 1 January 2026.

The superseded 24% standard and 14% reduced rows are lower bounds (confirmed applying on 1 January 2022); vero.fi confirms their end dates - 24% to 25.5% on 1 September 2024 and 14% to 13.5% on 1 January 2026 - but not when those rates began.

Lower-bound rows - reduced2 (2022-01-01): the `from` date is the earliest a source confirms the rate applied, not necessarily its true start (confirmed applying on 1 January 2022 by the Tax Foundation's January 2022 table of VAT rates (sourced from the Commission's Taxes in Europe Database)).
